en: Sepia-toned wartime postcard showing British (and possibly Allied) officers in uniform standing and conversing on an open field marked with white lines, likely a military camp or parade ground. The printed French caption at the top identifies the scene as the Lembet camp near Salonique (Thessaloniki), featuring General Mahon and staff officers. A reference number and publisher line are also visible, along with a modern watermark from elia.org.gr at the bottom.
